content: Announcing the limited preview of Azure compute templates, a new capability that simplifies virtual machine (VM) configuration management by enabling customers to define, version, and reuse standardized VM configurations across deployments. With compute templates, customers can create a reusable configuration baseline for common VM settings, including OS, storage, and security, and store it as a versioned instance profile in Azure Compute Gallery. Key benefits include: Simplified VM deployments: Define common configurations once and reuse them across supported VM deployments. Improved consistency: Reduce configuration drift and maintenance overhead through standardized, versioned configurations. Flexible deployment options: Apply templates to single-instance VMs and VM adaptive placement while supporting deployment-specific settings and overrides. Streamlined management: Manage reusable configurations independently of individual deployment requests. During the limited preview, compute templates are available through REST APIs for supported single-instance VMs, including VM adaptive placement. Preview registration and subscription enablement are required. VM scale sets and Azure Compute Fleet are not currently supported. Learn more: Announcement blog Azure compute templates documentation
